title: DASC Qwen3.6 Ascend piercing

paper.title: DASC: Decay-Aware State Compression for Hybrid Linear-Attention Serving

objective: Pierce DASC using the HYPIC-style evidence loop: method-chain parity, architecture fit, one-switch cache-hit A/B, Ascend correctness, matched performance, and E2E quality evidence.
delivery_constraint: Final runnable implementation must execute on Ascend through a plugin-owned monkeypatch path. Do not modify upstream vLLM, vLLM-Ascend, CANN, model weights, or original images; CPU/offline probes are only gates, not delivery.
next_actions: Keep the verified dense-storage numerical canary as a closed reachability result; do not tune or benchmark it as a performance candidate.
Keep the immutable v12r4 root as a failed graph-capture result: real DASC activation passed, but the first-spec order was not instrumented and must not be inferred from model order.

Keep commit 373b448 and immutable v12r5 artifacts as the rejected first-spec dispatch attempt; the adapter fired on four ranks but storage_first and dispatch_first were already the same attention layer and graph capture failed identically.
Keep the failed adapter out of the active plugin tree while preserving its Git history.

Complete the paper-to-code parity matrix and label the current implementation paper-derived DASC-NR Ascend adaptation until an author repository is released or the missing SGLang mechanisms are independently reproduced.

Use the graph-boundary successor at commit ff350dc: scheduler-owned compact storage stays authoritative, fixed-address dense workspaces stay permanently bound, metadata remapping and restore/checkpoint occur outside the captured model call.
Keep the complete pinned-image software gate: 45 tests passed, including replay with changing block IDs, stable workspace/index pointers, shape variants, and exception cleanup.

Wait for exclusive physical NPU4-7 availability. A running vllm-ascend container currently declares all eight NPUs and is starting a DP2 x TP4 service; do not stop it, share the cards, or launch the successor while that claim is active.
Prepare a new immutable v12r6 result root and owned container from the preserved v12r5 launch identity; refuse overwrite, recheck ownership after lock acquisition, and run only once.
Do not start formal performance or quality work unless a materially different successor passes service, strict canary, activation, ownership, and physical-byte verification.
Use commit 5f93b14 cache-hit quality adapter for formal quality runs; --require-cache-hit must fail closed on a zero hit delta.
Use the hash-pinned tokenizer context audit and max_model_len=44032 for both formal arms; reject truncation and the preserved invalid two-token audit.
Only after a materially different successor passes the physical mechanism gate, run the one-switch cache-hit TTFT and input-throughput benchmark.
